title: SOURCE Participant
details: Funding: [Support of Undergraduate Research and Creative Endeavors](https://case.edu/studentlife/ugresearch/find-programs-and-funding/undergraduate-research-office-funded-programs) (SOURCE).

Project: an algorithm for maximal disc decompositions of galactic rotation curves, applied to the SPARC database to extract lower bounds on the dark matter content of the sample galaxies. Published in [Starkman et al. 2018](item:maximum-discs).
